subject: implementer
reason: About 6 files over Catalog.API and WebApp, one change running end to end; no parallelism to gain.
mode_reason: About 6 files over Catalog.API and WebApp, one change running end to end; no parallelism to gain.

items.goal: Sort the whole filtered catalog on the server: the v2 GET /api/catalog/items gets an optional sort (name-asc|name-desc|price-asc|price-desc) applied before paging, CatalogService and Catalog.razor pass a ?sort= query parameter through, and catalog-sort.js navigates to the sorted URL (page reset, localStorage pref restored by URL replace when ?sort is missing) instead of reordering cards.
items.modelReason: Straightforward cross-layer change; the JS and URL state handling needs care but no hard design work.
items.verifyReason: The bug is visible in the browser: sorted order across catalog pages and the Sort control's persisted state.

alternatives.option: Keep client-side sort but fetch all items into the WebApp and page in memory
alternatives.reason: Moves paging out of the API and loads the whole catalog per request; breaks the count/paging contract.

alternatives.option: Persist the sort in a cookie read during SSR instead of a query param
alternatives.reason: Needs HttpContext plumbing in static SSR; the query param composes with the existing GetUriWithQueryParameter links for free.

items.reason: Straightforward cross-layer change; the JS and URL state handling needs care but no hard design work.
